title: Cell-pair traversal telemetry contract (L10)
description: Per-edge routing event emission. See ADR-047.

invariants.name: required_fields
invariants.description: 7 required fields present on every event.

invariants.name: optional_fields
must: may be absent on minimal events

invariants.name: emit_on_completion
invariants.description: Both success and failure path emit.
must: success=true on hit, success=false on failure
anti-tunnel mining depends on failure events

invariants.name: no_on_path_overhead
must: emission does NOT block routing return

invariants.name: retention_30_days
invariants.description: events.jsonl rotation keeps cell-pair events >= 30 days.
must: tunnel mining (ADR-042) has full window data available
